content: Petili na Kolinelio
Jwabi mundu jumu ku Kaisalia jobunkema Kolinelio, nkolongu wi kikundi sa alonda sebikikema, “Kikundi suku Italia.”
Jabi mundu jwaamboni, jombi pamu na bandu boka buku nyumba jaki babia bandu babunzetake Sapanga nukunndumbali, jaajangatya hindu aka kapuku bingi nukundoba Sapanga kila lisoba.
Lisoba limu sa tisa lyobamutu, jabona pee pangwendu majambu kuhuma kwaka Sapanga ntumi jukunani jwaka Sapanga jujingi nkati nukumpwagi, “Kolinelio!”

Kolinelio andingaliya ntumi jukunani jola koni jujogopa, andalukia, “Kibiki Bambu?” Ntumi jukunani jola jwapwaga, “Sapanga jujetaki kuloba kwaku na matambiku gaku gawaapeki haka kapuku henu nga jugujewe.
Heno, waatuma bandu ku Yopa bukunkema mundu jumu jobunkema Simoni, liina lengi Petili.
Jombi jubi ku nyumba jaka Simoni jojulenganake ngosi, nyumba jaki jibi mulutengu ju nhanga.”
Ntumi jukunani jojulongila na Kolinelio jola hejabia jubokiki, Kolinelio jaakema atumisi baki abeli nundonda waki jumu joanzetake Sapanga,
jaapwagila majambu goka gagapitii, nakaatuma ku Yopa.
Kilabu jaki, bandu atatu bala koni akona ajenda, lakini ebaegaliya kuhika ku Yopa, Petili jwakwela kunani kukipagaa sa nyumba, kwabii sa sita lyobamutu jajenda kundoba Sapanga.
Jabona inzala, jwatokulya kula posu. Pababia ahanda posu, jwabona hindu kuhuma kwaka Sapanga.
Jwabona kunani kwaka Sapanga kuogwiki na sindu ngati shuka bikihulu pai koni bikikamwi kona yoka nsesi.
Nkati ja shuka jela mwabi na kila aina ji inyama, inyama yana magolu nsesi, inyama yeikwaba pundema ni ijuni yukunani.
Ndi jajowana sauti kuhuma kunani, “Petili, jumuka usinza, ukulaje!”
Petili jwajibwa, “Ngahela Bambu, nengase nhwaiki kuonza sindu sokapi seakaniki kula au kipija.”
Sauti jela jajowanika kabee koni jumpwagi, “Hindu yeisapisiki na Sapanga wahikema ipija!”
Lijambu heli lahengiki mala patatu, ndi shuka jela jakelabuka kabee kunani.
Petili pajabi jwakona juholale ndaba jaki majambu gala jutei kugabona, apalapa bandu bajwaatumiki Kolinelio bahikapala baada jibona nyumba jaka Simoni,
bakema sukujamali, “Boo, jubi nngeni konioku jobunkema Petili?”
Petili jwabi jwakona juwasali majambu gajugabweni, ndi pala Loho jaka Sapanga jumpwagila, “Jowana! Abi bandu atatu, atenda kukupala.
Uhuluka wala wisita kujenda pamu nabu ndaba naatumiki nepane.”
Ndi pala, Petili jwauluka pai, nakaapwagi bandu bala, “Nepani ndi jomumpala. Nhikiki pamba ndaba ja kike.”

Bombi bapwaga, “Jututumiki nkolongu jwa alonda jobunkema Kolinelio, jojuwe mundu wa asapi joanzetake Sapanga na Ayaudi boti antende isima. Ntumi jukunani ampwagila jukukoka kunyumba jaki ili jujowana malobi gawampwagila.”
Petili jwatenda kwa ajopa, jaapekya pandu pukugone ikilu jela. Kilabu jaki, Petili jwatumbulya sapwali pamu na bombi, na bandu bangi ba bunhobale Kilisitu buku Yopa kola bajenda pamu najombi.
Lisoba la pili jaki bahika ku Kaisalia na kola Kolinelio jwabi jwaalendale pamu na alongu baki na akosi baki bangi bajwabi jwaakokiki.
Petili pajwabi jutenda kujingi mu nyumba, Kolinelio jwapita kunza kunzopa, jwapega magoti nukunzinami pai.
Lakini Petili jwatenda kuntondabe, nukumpwagi, “Jemaje, hata nepani na mundu pena.”
Petili jwaendalya kulonge na Kolinelio koni ajingi mu nyumba kojaakoli bandu bingi atemi pamu.

Petili jaapwagila, “Mwanganya mmanyiki mundu juku Uyahudi jokapi, akolongu badini akaniki jwijongana na bandu banga Ayaudi. Lakini Sapanga jumoliki nammbona mundu jokapi kuba ngasejujetakeka kwaka Sapanga au mpija.
Henu, henngemiki nane nhikiki sanga kujogopa. Henu, nundaluki, nngemi kike?”
Kolinelio japwaga, “Masoba gatatu gagapetiki, lisaa ngati lele, la tisa lyoba mutu, nabi ndenda kuloba mu nyumba. Mala pee, mundu jojwabi juweti ingobu yeing'aliki jwajemiki palongi jangu,
japwaga, ‘Kolinelio! Kuloba kwaku na nhupi yaku yewapeke aka kapuku ijetakiki na Sapanga.
Ntuma mundu ku Yopa jukunkema mundu jumu jobunkema Simoni, liina lengi Petili, jubi kunyumba jaka Simoni jojulenganake ngosi pambipi nunhanga.’
Ndienu apalapa naatuma bandu kwaku, naweapa utei sapi kuhika. Henu, twepani tubi pani palongi jaka Sapanga kujoane sokapi sejukutumiki Bambu kutupwagi.”
Kulonge kwaka Petili
Ndienu Petili jatumbulya kupwaga, “Henu manyiki sakaka Sapanga ngasejubagu bando.
Mundu jukuhuma nndema jokapi joanzetake Sapanga nukutenda gajupala Sapanga jutenda kunzopa.
Lende ndi lijambu lejulipelika Sapanga kwa bandu buku Izilaeli, koni julandi Lijambu la Amboni lelileta lukwali kupete indela jaka Yesu Kilisitu, Bambu wa bandu boka.
Mwanganya mmanyiki lijambu lelapitila ku nndema juku Yudea, kutumbuli ku Galilaya baada ju ubatisu gojwaalandila Yohana bandu.

Namwanganya mmanyiki Sapanga heanhagwi Yesu juku Nazaleti kuhenga lihengu laki koni ampeki makili ga Loho jaka Sapanga nukumpeke uwesu. Sapanga jwabi pamu najombi jwajenda koni na kola jwakatenda majambu ga sapi na kwaalamisa bandu bababi lyatukali lijobi.
Twepani ndi twetwabona majambu goka ga jutendiki munndema ja Ayaudi nuku Yelusalemu. Bunkoma sukumbambali mu nsalaba,
lakini Sapanga anyoa lisoba latatu, nuku nhwesesa jubonikana kwa bandu,
ngasejabonakini kwa bandu bote, ila kwa bandu bababi ahaguliwi na Sapanga ili bagabona haga nukulonge, ndi twepani twetwakula na kunywa pamu najombi baada jukuyoka kwaki kuhuma kwa bandu baawi.
Jutulagalakya kulandi Lijambu la Amboni kwa bandu boti nakaapwagi bandu jombi ndi jojuaguliki na Sapanga kuba jukutemu bandu baawi na bandu bomi.
Alota baka Sapanga boti bundongali jombi kupwaga boti ba bunhobale jwitenda kundekake mahakau gaki goka kupete liina laki.”
Bandu banga Ayaudi ajopa Loho jaka Sapanga
Petili pajwabi jwakona juendale kulonge, Loho jaka Sapanga jaahulukya boti bababi ajowane lilobi laka Sapanga.
Ayaudi babunzetake Sapanga babahikiki pamu na Petili bala kuhuma ku Yopa, basangi kubona Sapanga jwaapeki nhupi ja Loho jaka Sapanga hata bandu banga Ayaudi,
ndaba baajowana bakalongila kwa luga ingeni koni bundumbali Sapanga. Ndi Petili japwaa,
“Bandu haba bunzopiki Loho jaka Sapanga jaka Sapanga ngati twabete hetunzopaje. Boo, jubijokapi jojuwesa kwapenga biibatiswa kwa masi?”
Henu, jaamua abatiswa kwiliina laka Yesu Kilisitu. Nabombi bunndoba jutama nabu kwamasoba gangi kidogu.
